name: Aria Hotel Prague
insider_take: This musical masterpiece sits in the heart of Lesser Town, where every floor celebrates a different musical genre and composer.
whats_special: The Aria Hotel is the world's first music-themed luxury boutique hotel, featuring rooms dedicated to legends like Mozart, Beethoven, and jazz greats. Each of the hotel's four floors represents a different musical style - Classical, Opera, Contemporary, and Jazz. The rooftop terrace offers stunning views of Prague Castle, just steps away.
pro_tip: Request a room on the Jazz floor for the most vibrant atmosphere, and don't miss the complimentary iPad loaded with music that matches your room's theme.
dont_miss: The hotel's Music Garden with its glass wall of over 9,000 LP records, and take advantage of being a 2-minute walk from the famous Charles Bridge. The on-site Coda Restaurant offers innovative cuisine with musical performances.
pros: Unique music-themed boutique hotel with individually designed rooms inspired by musical legends
Prime location in Lesser Town with stunning views of Prague Castle and Charles Bridge
Michelin-starred Coda Restaurant offering exceptional fine dining experience
Luxurious rooftop terrace and garden with panoramic city views
Personalized service with music concierge and extensive vinyl collection
cons: Limited room inventory due to boutique size may require advance booking
Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning and prime location
